text: 根据《财政部关于下达2024年汽车以旧换新补贴中央财政预拨资金预算的通知》（财建〔2024〕129号）、《财政部国家发展改革委关于2024年消费品以旧换新资金清算结果的通知》（财建〔2026〕60号）、你厅（局）《申请收回2024年消费品以旧换新资金情况表》，现收回部分中央财政2024年已预拨你省（区、兵团）用于汽车以旧换新的财政贴息和奖补资金（详见附件）。由你省（区、兵团）上解中央财政，列入2026年政府收支分类科目“2300602专项上解支出”，通过2026年中央财政与地方财政年终结算办理。
text_en: According to the Ministry of Finance's Notice on Issuing the Central Government Budget for Pre-allocated Subsidy Funds for Trade-ins of Old Automobiles in 2024 (Cai Jian [2024] No. 129), the Ministry of Finance and National Development and Reform Commission's Notice on the Settlement Results of 2024 Consumer Goods Trade-in Funds (Cai Jian [2026] No. 60), and your department's (bureau's) Application Form for Recovering 2024 Consumer Goods Trade-in Funds, part of the central government's 2024 pre-allocated fiscal interest subsidies and reward funds for automobile trade-ins in your province (region, corps) are hereby recovered (see attachment). Your province (region, corps) shall remit the funds to the central government treasury, include them under the 2026 government revenue and expenditure classification item "2300602 Special Remittance Expenditure," and process them through the 2026 year-end settlement between the central and local governments.
